learning_outcomes.text: Explain what .NET Aspire is and the cloud-native problems it addresses
Create an Aspire solution with AppHost and ServiceDefaults
Model resources and service-to-service references in the app model
Use Aspire integrations for databases, caching and messaging
Use the Aspire dashboard for telemetry and diagnosing connections
Understand service discovery, health checks and observability defaults

integrative_case: Stand up a cloud-native shop: create an Aspire AppHost that orchestrates a web frontend, an API, a Postgres database and a Redis cache, wire references so service discovery configures connections, and use the dashboard to find a failing dependency.

verification_sources.note: .NET Aspire overview, orchestration, integrations and dashboard
